interpretation: Given a 12-period baseline, the declared test and a 80% power requirement, single-period changes smaller than 22.44% of the period total are not reliably distinguishable from normal variation. Sustained changes over 6 periods below 10.78% are likewise not reliably distinguishable. Absence of an alarm is NOT evidence of semantic continuity.
assumption_bias_direction: The iid assumption is OPTIMISTIC. Serial correlation and seasonality inflate the true standard error, making the true floor LARGER than stated here. Step 7 measures how much.
